stem: Duplicate transaction events with the same txn_id can arrive up to 30 minutes apart. You want to remove duplicates in a stream while keeping state size bounded. Which approach fits best?
choices: dropDuplicates(["txn_id"]) with no watermark
distinct() on the stream
A MERGE in foreachBatch against the entire target table on every batch
withWatermark("event_time", "30 minutes").dropDuplicatesWithinWatermark(["txn_id"])
explanation_ja: dropDuplicatesWithinWatermark は、ウォーターマークの範囲内だけ txn_id を覚えておき、古いものは忘れるので状態が増え続けません。ウォーターマークなしの dropDuplicates は全部覚え続けます。

stem: A streaming DataFrame of transactions is joined to a static Delta table account_dim, which a separate batch job updates once a day. Which statement is true?
choices: Each micro-batch reads the latest version of account_dim, so updates are picked up without restarting the stream.
The static table is read once when the stream starts, so the stream must be restarted to see updates.
Stream-static joins require a watermark on both sides.
Stream-static joins are not supported when the static side is a Delta table.
explanation_ja: 静的側が Delta テーブルなら、マイクロバッチごとに最新のバージョンを読むので、再起動しなくても更新が反映されます。ウォーターマークが必要なのはストリーム同士の結合です。

stem: A streaming query groups transactions by account_id and computes sum(amount) with no watermark and no time window. Which output mode will fail when the query starts?
choices: complete
update
append
None of them; all three are allowed.
explanation_ja: ウォーターマークのない集計は、どの行も「もう変わらない」と決められないので、確定した行だけ出す append モードは使えません。complete と update は使えます。

stem: Two streaming queries write to two different Delta tables but are configured with the same checkpointLocation. What is correct?
choices: This is fine, because the sinks are different tables.
Each streaming query must have its own unique checkpoint location.
Spark automatically creates a separate subfolder for each query.
It works only when both queries use trigger(availableNow=True).
explanation_ja: チェックポイントはクエリごとの進み具合の記録なので、クエリごとに別の場所が必要です。共有すると、進み具合が混ざって壊れます。

stem: An Auto Loader stream uses cloudFiles.schemaEvolutionMode = "rescue". New files start to include a column channel that is not in the schema. What happens?
choices: The stream fails, and the new column is added to the schema on restart.
The stream keeps running, the schema does not change, and the channel values go into the _rescued_data column.
The channel column is silently dropped and not stored anywhere.
The schema is updated to include channel without the stream failing.
explanation_ja: rescue モードではスキーマを変えず、ストリームも止めずに、新しい列の値を _rescued_data 列に入れます。A は既定の addNewColumns、C は none モードの動きです。
